Coverage gaps surfaced: no G12R-selective inhibitor or G12R-restricted TCR-T exists in the clinic; no solid-tumor KMT2C/COMPASS basket found (KMT2C axis returns zero trials, as the validator predicted). Line-counting is the case's recurring eligibility hinge: recurrence 4 months post-adjuvant counts as a prior line under protocols that state the 6-month convention (ASP5834, LB1908, AN9025) but leaves 1L trials (RASolute 303 excepted — adjuvant not excluded there) and '>=1 prior advanced-setting line' trials convention-dependent. RASolute 303's metastatic-diagnosis-within-6-weeks window makes restaging/biopsy urgent.

notes: All 18 PMIDs verified via PubMed E-utilities (existence + abstract-level claim match for every effect size quoted); 4 DOIs carried from upstream-verified rows or resolved via esearch. One upstream attribution corrected rather than carried: ESMO's April 2025 Express Update grades gemcitabine+conventional paclitaxel (GEMPAX) I,B after FOLFIRINOX; gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel is III,C there and not EMA/FDA-approved as 2L, so the launching brief's 'GnP I,B' was fixed against pmid:40287191 (counted as the 1 correction). Re-resection of isolated local recurrence found no NCCN/ESMO carriage and is recorded inside the radiotherapy row rather than as a standard option. relationship_to_targeted_options filled for 9 rows against ranks 1-6; the hard conflict named is the RASolute 303 six-week consent window that any chemotherapy start spends. index.md injection pending: build_report.py requires the reporter's executive_summary.md, which does not exist yet; re-run run_case.sh after /reporter.

Ranked all 12 included pipeline candidates. Rank 1 Lu-177 zolbetuximab radioconjugate, carried with both halves of its story: only in-vivo PDAC data plus crossfire tolerance of a 60% antigen, and no reachable trial (NCT07595237/NCT07707531 both graded not_yet_accessible, no Western program). Low-positive hedge carried on all three CLDN18.2 rows since 60% sits below the 75% registrational cutoff. Fragility flags preserved on pi3k-gamma (weakest in file), hypomethylation (2011, amplifier not driver), acbi4, cdk8, parp-kmt2c and ph20-CAR-T; statin row carries a High counter-productive MoA for antagonism with the Y220C reactivator route. Built page + offline HTML + PDF; refreshed index.md case-output and Downloads injectors only (reporter runs full run_case.sh after).

First narrative run; earlier docs artifacts were narrative-less renders and are superseded. 326-word narrative: 20 surveyed, 16 never measured, both essential rows are the measured-not-hardened pair. Germline panel named the survey's single highest-value order (blood draw, no tissue, approved drug class behind a positive; NCCN-recommended since 2019, onset in the 50s). CLDN18.2 60% at 2+/3+ carried as a threshold call, never collapsed: below zolbetuximab's 75% registrational cutoff, clear of satri-cel 2+/40%, ASP2138 1+, and the radioligand protocol's 2+/20% threefold; clone unnamed, tissue archival. Archival-vs-recurrence asymmetry carried (83.3% concordance, losses clustering in local recurrence and liver metastasis, 54.6% biopsy sensitivity, negative small core is weak evidence of loss). MSS/TMB 0.83 carried as decision-relevant negatives closing single-agent PD-1; KRAS G12R outside G12C/G12D coverage; KMT2C kept in scope at user request; out-of-scope panel targets stated as deliberate. Gaps collapse to two orders: one blood draw (germline panel + HLA class I typing) and one recurrence biopsy (DNA+RNA NGS plus six-stain block cut incl. CLDN18.2 CDx re-stain). Humanizer audit-pass fixes: trimmed 367 to 326 words, broke adjacent which-which repetition, replaced copula-evading phrasing, no em-dashes or curly quotes. Scanner allowlist extended (scripts/scan_for_phi.py _BYDESIGN_NAMES) for the biomarker-survey artifact names, mirroring the standard_of_care entries, because fda: reference slugs carry day-precision approval dates by design; pytest 125 passed. Injectors re-run directly (build_report.py full run blocked on missing executive_summary.md); full run_case.sh left to the reporter. mkdocs --strict clean; PHI scan clean. Not committed, not pushed per instruction.
